# SheetJS CE 0.20.3

Vendored unmodified from the [official SheetJS CDN](https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz), following the [official installation guide](https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/). The npm registry's 0.18.5 release is obsolete. This fixed tarball also avoids registry-host rewriting in dashboard/.npmrc.

SHA-256: `8dc73fc3b00203e72d176e85b50938627c7b086e607c682e8d3c22c02bb99fe8`.

The original package contains its own license. Update only from an official fixed release and rerun the document compatibility tests. package-lock.json additionally fixes its npm integrity value.
